description: One YAML, whole agentic pipeline. `source: + steps: + outputs:` — 8 ops (llm_call, route, debate, critique_loop, synthesize, mcp_call, tool_use_loop, handoff). Typed named `inputs:` on every text-emitting op for multi-input joins by port name. First-class partition fields (`partition_type` / `partition_start` / `partition_values` / `dynamic_partition_name` / `partition_dimensions`) mirror sibling ml_pipeline / polars_pipeline / warehouse_pipeline. LiteLLM-backed for LLM ops.

inputs.description: Source text — literal, url, file, or upstream_asset (kind = literal|url|file|upstream_asset). Or omit and let an `mcp_call` step drive the pipeline directly.

outputs.description: One or more first-class asset outputs (declared via outputs.assets: [step_ids]); each is a dict `{text, ...op-specific fields}`. Plus optional text / json sinks.

asset_name_prefix.label: Asset Name Prefix
asset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for emitted asset names. Each step listed in outputs.assets becomes '{prefix}_{step_id}'.

source.label: Source
source.description: Data source. kind = literal | file | url | upstream_asset. All string fields are {partition_key}-templated.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Ordered pipeline steps. Each: {id, op, ...op-specific args}. Two wiring modes (compose per step): (1) legacy `source: <step_id>` reads that step's text into `{text}`; (2) typed `inputs: {port: {from: step_id} | {literal: value}}` — each port becomes a `{port_name}` placeholder in prompt_template / system_prompt (and, for mcp_call, in string tool_args). 8 ops available: llm_call | route | debate | critique_loop | synthesize | mcp_call | tool_use_loop | handoff. Full per-op JSON Schema is published under manifest agent_hints.steps_schemas (discriminated union on `op`).

outputs.label: Outputs
outputs.description: Output declaration. Shape: {assets: [<step_ids>], text_sinks: [{from, path}], json_sinks: [{from, path}]}. `assets:` step outputs become first-class Dagster assets; sinks are side effects. All sink paths are `{partition_key}`-aware.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Group name for emitted assets. Default: 'agents'.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional tags for the emitted assets.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type shared by every emitted asset. Omit for unpartitioned. Use `{partition_key}` in source text / URL / file path / sink paths to substitute per partition.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for time-based partition types (daily/weekly/monthly/hourly/multi).

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated string OR list — the fixed partition keys for static/multi partitioning. e.g. ['NVDA', 'TSLA', 'META'] or 'NVDA,TSLA,META'.

dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name
dynamic_partition_name.description: Name for the DynamicPartitionsDefinition when partition_type='dynamic'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name}. Set INSTEAD of partition_type for multi-dimensional partitioning.
